en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Imran Bin Musa, from Musa Bin Ja’far, from Amro Bin Saeed Al Madainy, from Muhammad Bin Umar Al Sabaty who said, 
‘I asked Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> about a man who bequeathed to me (to be an executor), and ordered me to give something to an uncle of his during every year. So the uncle died’.
So he<sup>asws</sup> wrote: ‘Give it to his inheritors’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from ‘Imran ibn Musa from Musa ibn Ja‘far from ‘Amr ibn Sa‘id al-Mad’iniy from Muhammad ibn ‘Umar al-Sabatiy who has narrated the following: “I once asked abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a man who made a will that said I must give something to his uncle every year, but the uncle has died.
He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, wrote, ‘You must give it to his heirs.’”
